artifacts.summary: Recommends making validate-bounded-waiter.sh heredoc-aware (Option 1): strip heredoc body lines from the text tested by the existing three-leg conjunction via a conservative, self-contained awk pass, bailing to today's unstripped-text verdict on any ambiguity; rejects narrowing the conjunction (Option 2) and documentation-only (Option 3) as primary fixes.

memory_candidates.content: A PreToolUse hook whose matcher is "Bash" and whose detector tests the raw tool_input.command string (not Write/Edit content) must treat heredoc bodies as data, not control flow -- a heredoc that documents a forbidden shell shape as prose satisfies a purely textual conjunction test just as literally as a live instance of that shape. Sibling hooks matched on Write|Edit (validate-no-task-references.sh, validate-no-record-versioning.sh) never hit this because their payload is already the complete target content with no embedded sub-document; it is specific to Bash-matcher textual-shape detectors.

record-version-patterns.sh's strip_exempt_regions() is a reusable implementation SHAPE (not a shared library) for region-stripping before pattern-testing: a single awk pass that blanks lines between an open/close condition while passing every other line through unchanged. The same shape generalizes to stripping heredoc bodies (open = a <<DELIM/<<-DELIM opener not followed by a third '<', close = a line exactly/whitespace-stripped equal to DELIM) ahead of any textual conjunction test, as long as the stripper bails to the original unstripped text on anything it cannot parse confidently (multiple heredocs, non-identifier delimiter, unterminated body) rather than guessing.
